title: xbintsc project config
description: Project build configuration read from xbintsc.config.json.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint pointing at this schema.

entry.description: Entry TypeScript file, resolved against this config's directory.

lto.description: Compile program and runtime to LTO bitcode and link with lld.

extNative.description: Paths to native C++/Rust extension manifests.

features.description: Optional link features to force on, e.g. ["media", "gpu", "images", "shaping", "webgl", "storage"] or ["all"].

noFeatures.description: Optional link features to keep out even when auto-detection finds a use.

moduleOverrides.description: Replace module specifiers with local files, e.g. { "jiti": "stubs/jiti.ts" }. Keys match the exact specifier text; values are file paths (with extension) resolved against this config's directory. An override wins over node_modules, Node built-ins and extension modules.

storage.description: Storage backend for the storage extension (localStorage, sessionStorage, indexedDB). Defaults to memory.

backend.description: Where the database lives. Default: memory (an in-memory SQLite database).

path.description: Database file path for backend: file, resolved against this config's directory (absolute paths are used as-is).

bundle.description: macOS only: also produce a <name>.app bundle.

console.description: Windows only: keep the console subsystem (a console window) instead of the default Windows subsystem, so stdout/stderr are visible while debugging a GUI program.
